title: Rename the drift-check skill from reconcile-issue-map to reconcile
summary: Renamed the drift-check skill to /reconcile across skills, baseline, README and guide; orion update already pruned the old managed folder, so only two tests were added. Version 20.

deferred.what: A project whose own unmarked skill is already named 'reconcile' loses orion's drift check on its next orion update: the managed reconcile-issue-map copy is pruned and the new reconcile is skipped as not an orion copy, so 'Drift found: run /reconcile' sends the person to their own unrelated skill
deferred.why: Needs a design choice (keep the old copy until the new one installs, or warn loudly), outside a rename
